behaviour: Adds an optional highlightedNotificationId prop that marks the matching row as current, styles it and scrolls it into view once.
rules: 1. NotificationsTableProps gains highlightedNotificationId?: string with the TSDoc comment /** Id of a notification to highlight and scroll into view */.

2. const scrolledIdRef = useRef<string | undefined>(undefined); const highlightRef = useCallback((element: HTMLDivElement | null) => { if (element && highlightedNotificationId && scrolledIdRef.current !== highlightedNotificationId) { scrolledIdRef.current = highlightedNotificationId; element.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'center' }); } }, [highlightedNotificationId]);

3. In the compact-data column, the outer <Flex gap="4" align="center"> gets, only when notification.id === highlightedNotificationId: ref={highlightRef}, className={styles.highlighted} and aria-current="true"; other rows render exactly as before (no extra attributes).
4. When highlightedNotificationId is undefined or matches no row, the table behaves exactly as today (FR-13).

behaviour: Documents the unread notifications home-page card and the notification deep link.
rules: 1. New section '## Home page card': in the new frontend system the plugin provides the `home-page-widget:notifications/unread-notifications` extension, enabled by default, which appears in the home page **Add Widget** dialog and can be placed through `page:home` `defaultConfig` with component `HomePageUnreadNotifications` (yaml example under app.extensions).

2. The section states the card lists your five newest unread notifications, lets you mark each one as read, refreshes live when `@backstage/plugin-signals` is installed and otherwise checks for new notifications every 60 seconds; it shows how to turn it off with `- home-page-widget:notifications/unread-notifications: false`.

3. New section '## Linking to a notification': `/notifications?id=<notification id>` opens the notifications page and highlights that notification when it is in the displayed list; opening the link does not mark the notification as read.

behaviour: Adds the home-page card and the notification deep link to the frontend usage guide.
